line: ASUS ProArt PZ14 (HT7407, 2026 Copilot+ creator tablet)
config_name: ProArt PZ14 14" 3K 144Hz Lumina Pro OLED tablet — Snapdragon X2 Elite (18-core, 80 TOPS NPU), 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD (retail tier unverified; ASUS CA lists up to 32GB/1TB)

specs.ram_type: LPDDR5x soldered (unverified tier — ASUS CA lists 'up to 32GB')
specs.storage_type: M.2 NVMe (unverified tier — ASUS CA lists 'up to 1TB')
specs.display_type: ASUS Lumina Pro OLED, 16:10 touchscreen, anti-reflection coating
specs.ports: 2x USB4 Type-C, 3.5mm (per line spec); detachable Bluetooth keyboard + stand cover
specs.keyboard_notes: Detachable Bluetooth keyboard/stand cover (sold with tablet per ASUS CA); rated per accessory per SCHEMA
specs.os: Windows 11 Home (ASUS recommends 11 Pro for business)

battery.notes: No verified capacity or pro battery test. HT1406 predecessor was 70.91Wh; Snapdragon Arm + OLED class typically 12-15h light use. Estimate, disclosed.

price.notes: ESTIMATE — no Canadian retail price verifiable from this machine on 2026-11-24: BBY search API DNS-unreachable, bestbuy.ca page timed out, DDG bot-walled, Amazon.ca unconfirmed, ASUS CA 'where to buy' lists offers via JS only. ASUS CA confirms the PZ14 (HT7407) is an active Canadian product.

praises: Snapdragon X-series efficiency gives genuinely all-day OLED battery life on Copilot+ tablets — a step-change over the x86 PZ14 HT1401 it replaces [synthesized from Snapdragon X Copilot+ tablet owner consensus]
Bright anti-reflection OLED touchscreen with 144Hz VRR is excellent for pen sketching and color-accurate review work [synthesized from ASUS Lumina Pro OLED owner themes]
Detachable keyboard plus built-in kickstand gives flexible tablet/laptop/stand modes that creators like for on-location work [synthesized]
MPP 2.6 pen support with a slim light tablet body is popular for note-taking and markup [synthesized]
Fanless/quiet Arm operation and instant-wake mobile-like experience praised by mobile creators [synthesized]
complaints: Windows-on-Arm app-translation gaps remain the top complaint: some creator plugins, drivers, anti-cheat games, and niche x86 software run poorly or not at all [synthesized from r/ASUS / Snapdragon X owner themes]
Detachable keyboard cover typing and trackpad feel worse than a real clamshell at this price [synthesized]
Kickstand ergonomics on soft surfaces and wobble in laptop mode are recurring complaints on kickstand tablets [synthesized]
Soldered RAM/SSD with steep capacity tiers; Adreno GPU is weak for 3D/render-heavy creator work [synthesized from platform facts]
ASUS Arm driver/firmware quirks (sleep drain, MyASUS bloat) reported across ASUS Copilot+ lines [synthesized]

design_philosophy: The ProArt PZ14 is ASUS's creator-flavored Windows tablet: a thin Snapdragon-powered detachable with a factory-grade Lumina Pro OLED, pen support, and a Bluetooth keyboard/stand cover — aiming at mobile illustrators, photographers, and note-heavy creators rather than raw workstation power. This entry represents the current Canadian PZ14 (HT7407, Snapdragon X2 Elite), which has replaced the 2025 HT1406 (X Elite) on ASUS Canada's store; RAM/storage tier sold in CA could not be verified, so the config is a disclosed estimate.
rating_notes: HONEST NULLS: no verifiable pro review found (NBC bot-walled, DDG captcha, Bing returned no review hits) — professional null. Price and RAM/storage tier are estimates (see price.notes). Release month estimated (Snapdragon X2 Elite generation). Ratings synthesized from Snapdragon X/X2 Copilot+ OLED tablet priors (Surface Pro 11 / Zenbook A14 class per SCHEMA calibration): Arm+OLED battery ~9, ecosystem capped ~6 for x86 app-translation caveats, gaming ~3.5 (Adreno iGPU, anti-cheat gaps), portability ~9 (0.79kg tablet + keyboard), ports capped low (2x USB4 only), creative_work 7 (superb panel, weak GPU), ai_ml 6 (80 TOPS NPU, unified memory, no CUDA). IP52 + MIL-STD durability per ASUS CA listing. All sentiment synthesized and disclosed — see SHARED-proart-pz14.md.
